title: Procore Technologies (PCOR) Slid Amid AI Disruption Concerns
excerpt: Wasatch Global Investors, an asset management company, released its “Small Cap Growth Strategy” Q2 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be download...
content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Mon, July 27, 2026 at 10:15 AM EDT 3 min read

Wasatch Global Investors, an asset management company, released its "Small Cap Growth Strategy" Q2 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. Small-cap equities experienced strong gains in the second quarter, primarily driven by companies associated with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the leadership within this sector remains narrow. Unprofitable companies and those benefiting from rapid AI-driven demand performed well. As a result, the strategy underperformed compared to the Russell 2000® Growth Index, which gained 25.71%. The strategy's disciplined focus on higher-quality businesses caused it to trail the benchmark, though several AI-related holdings contributed positively. The strategy prioritizes companies with sustainable growth potential, emphasizing the importance of quality investments. Overall, the strategy seeks to balance the transformative potential of AI with a commitment to long-term, quality investments. In addition, please check the Strategy's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, the Wasatch Small Cap Growth Strategy highlighted Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR). Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR), a technology company that provides a cloud-based construction management platform and related software products, detracted from the Fund's performance during the quarter. On July 24, 2026, Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR) closed at $42.83 per share. One-month return of Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR) was 9.10%, and its shares lost 44.12% over the past 52 weeks. Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR) has a market capitalization of $6.46 billion.

Wasatch Small Cap Growth Strategy stated the following regarding Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR) in its Q2 2026 investor update:

"Another detractor was Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:PCOR), a software company that manages construction projects. Many software stocks have sold off in 2026 due to concerns about how AI might disrupt software business models. The strategy does not have large exposure to software companies. But for the companies we do hold, we believe the market has underestimated the competitive moats that insulate the business from AI disruption or the ways in which the companies might actually benefit from AI, not be disrupted by it. Procore serves as an example. Procore's advantage lies not in its software code but in its extensive network of contractors and the proprietary data generated across thousands of projects. That network effect and dataset are significantly more difficult to replicate than the underlying software functionality, and we believe they position the company well in an AI-driven environment. AI could create more and better insights from that proprietary data."

2026 年 7 月 27 日星期一，美国东部时间上午 10:15 阅读 3 分钟

资产管理公司 Wasatch Global Investors 发布了 2026 年第二季度“小盘股增长策略”投资者信。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 小盘股在第二季度经历了强劲上涨，主要受到人工智能 (AI) 相关公司的推动。 然而，该领域的领先地位仍然有限。 未盈利的公司和受益于人工智能驱动的快速需求的公司表现良好。 因此，与上涨 25.71% 的 Russell 2000® 增长指数相比，该策略的表现较差。 该策略对高质量业务的严格关注导致其落后于基准，尽管一些与人工智能相关的持股做出了积极贡献。 该战略优先考虑具有可持续增长潜力的公司，强调优质投资的重要性。 总体而言，该战略旨在平衡人工智能的变革潜力与长期优质投资的承诺。 此外，请查看该策略的前五名持股，以了解其 2026 年的最佳选择。

Wasatch 小盘股增长战略在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点关注了 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR）。 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR）是一家提供基于云的施工管理平台和相关软件产品的科技公司，该公司本季度的表现拖累了该基金的业绩。 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：PCOR）收于每股 42.83 美元。 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR）的一个月回报率为 9.10%，其股价在过去 52 周内下跌了 44.12%。 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR）的市值为 64.6 亿美元。

Wasatch 小盘股增长策略在其 2026 年第二季度投资者更新中对 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR）做出了以下陈述：

“另一个批评者是 Procore Technologies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PCOR），这是一家管理建筑项目的软件公司。 由于担心人工智能可能会扰乱软件商业模式，许多软件股票在 2026 年遭到抛售。 该策略对软件公司的影响并不大。 但对于我们持有的公司来说，我们认为市场低估了使企业免受人工智能颠覆的竞争护城河，也低估了公司实际上可以从人工智能中受益而不是被人工智能颠覆的方式。 Procore 就是一个例子。 Procore 的优势不在于其软件代码，而在于其广泛的承包商网络以及数千个项目生成的专有数据。 网络效应和数据集比底层软件功能更难复制，我们相信它们使公司在人工智能驱动的环境中处于有利地位。 人工智能可以从专有数据中创造出更多更好的见解。”
